item: Lumped part rows read the own peak of the part; the first link sees the images of the board sides
why: heater_stats took the footprint node of the Lumped field and now takes the own peak of the part (fix/lumped-part-readout); and the first footprint-to-ring link is read from the logarithmic potential of the footprint with the mirror images of the board sides, so the part reads a few points hotter near a side and about 2 points hotter in the interior (both changes in this one file: every record holds both)
